content:
alex: Quick sync — can someone run a comparative bench for fused-kernel FlashAttention vs paged-KV + Flash on long sequences? PR #3892 is queued for merge but we need a perf matrix before gating.

alex: Details:
- Commit: 5f3a2d1 (branch: runtime/flash-fuse-3892)
- Image: redwood/runtime:rc-2026-03-12-hw
- Targets: seq lenses 4096 / 8192 / 16384, batch 1 and 2
- Modes: fp16, int8-quant
- Compare: (A) fused ops + flash, (B) paged-KV + flash (no fuse), (C) baseline (no flash, no fuse)
- Metrics: tokens/s, p50/p95/p99 latency, peak GPU memory, SM util, memcpy counts
- Run harness: bench-runner

alex: Example command (please paste logs + perflog link):
```
bench-runner \
  --image redwood/runtime:rc-2026-03-12-hw \
  --commit 5f3a2d1 \
  --seq-len 8192 --batch 1 --dtype fp16 \
  --kv paged --fuse-kernels true \
  --profile nvprof --flamegraph out.svg \
  --out /tmp/perflog/3892-8192-fused
```

alex: Target infra: dgx-02 or p4d-8x, please note node id. Need EOD PST results if possible. @maya @dmitri @zoe any volunteers? :eyes:

maya: I can pick this up on dgx-02. Will run the 6 combos (3 seq x 2 batch) for fp16 and int8; will post perflog URLs. Clarify: for "no fuse" do you want `--fuse-kernels false` or the separate branch? 

alex: --fuse-kernels false is fine for quick compare. Also please run a variant with `--kv paged=false` to show non-paged baseline.

dmitri: quick ask — capture `nvprof --metrics gld_throughput,gst_throughput,dram_read_throughput,dram_write_throughput` and peak allocated memory from nsys. Also set `--trace memcpy` if bench-runner supports it. I want memcpy heatmap for attention kernels.

maya: ack. I'll do nvprof + nsys. Running int8 requires the quant config file; using quant-configs/int8_default.json. Will ping once complete.

zoe: flagging one more thing: PR 3879 introduced an extra host memcpy in the attention prep path (see comment). Please run the experiment both with and without PR 3879 applied to isolate regression vs fusion impact. i.e. branches: main (base), main+3879, main+3879+3892.

ben: I'll open an ENG-GATE issue and attach a short checklist. Also pinging @eng-releases for merge freeze considerations.

ben: quick unit test snippet I'll add to the PR (pseudo):
```
def test_attention_no_extra_memcpy():
    run_small_model(seq=1024)
    assert host_memcpy_count('attention_prep') == 0
```

perf-bot: automated bench snapshot: rc-2026-03-12-hw @dgx-02
- seq=8192,b=1,fp16,fused: 320 tokens/s, p99=1230ms, peak_gpu=46.2GiB
- seq=8192,b=1,fp16,non-fused(paged): 265 tokens/s, p99=1420ms, peak_gpu=50.1GiB
- baseline(no flash): 210 tokens/s, p99=1890ms, peak_gpu=55.8GiB
(perf-bot) full logs: https://perflogs.internal/reports/3892/auto-8192

ci-bot: CI smoke for runtime/flash-fuse-3892 passed on quick-matrix. No functional failures.

maya: Results (dgx-02):
- seq=4096,b=1,fp16: fused 610 t/s (p99 420ms, peak 36.8GiB), paged 540 t/s (p99 520ms, peak 39.1GiB)
- seq=8192,b=1,fp16: fused 318 t/s (p99 1220ms, peak 46.3GiB), paged 262 t/s (p99 1408ms, peak 50.0GiB)
- seq=16384,b=1,fp16: fused 140 t/s (p99 3050ms, peak 62.5GiB), paged 120 t/s (p99 3420ms, peak 66.8GiB)
- int8 results similar shape but ~1.15x throughput in fused case, will upload detailed csv
- perflogs: https://perflogs.internal/u/maya/3892-matrix
- nvprof flamegraphs attached: https://perflogs.internal/u/maya/3892-flamegraphs.zip

maya: Also ran branch combos: main+3879 shows an extra host memcpy step labeled `attention_prep::host_copy` adding ~18ms per token window; that accounts for ~10-12% perf regression on paged case.

dmitri: saw the same memcpy in nvprof. SM util dropped ~6% in paged path with 3879. Suggest revert 3879 or move memcpy to pinned buffer to hide transfer cost.

zoe: I'll open ENG-ISSUE-1127 documenting the memcpy regression + proposed mitigation (pinned buffers or fused copy into kernel). Assign to @dmitri and tag perf. ETA for fix request: 2 sprints unless critical.

alex: Fantastic — thanks all. Next steps:
- @ben open gating issue and link perflogs (ENG-GATE-2045)
- @zoe open regression ticket (ENG-ISSUE-1127)
- @dmitri prototype pinned-buffer patch and bench again
- @maya paste the full CSVs + attach nvprof raw

alex: If we can get a quick revert of 3879 in a patch release that fixes the biggest perf hit, we can keep 3892 (fusion) on the docket for immediate follow-up. Revert candidate: runtime@main~1 (apply rollback diff).

ben: pinged @eng-releases and added ENG-GATE-2045 with the perflogs link.

maya: uploaded CSV + raw nsys: https://perflogs.internal/u/maya/3892-csv-and-nsys

alex: Thanks — marking this thread done for now. If anyone finds significantly different numbers on p4d, please post them here. :thumbsup:

zoe: opened ENG-ISSUE-1127: https://issues.internal/1127 — assigned to dmitri. :white_check_mark:

dmitri: will start a quick prototype tomorrow, tagging @maya for repro steps.

perf-bot: reminder scheduled bench tomorrow 08:00 UTC for extended quant runs.
